Glacier Lake

For the song, see Glacier Lake (song).
Glacier Lake
Area 12 km2

Glacier Lake (/ˈɡleɪʃər leɪk/) is a proglacial lake in the Northern Range.[1] It formed after the retreat of the Kessel Glacier.

The lake is a popular destination for anglers.[citation needed] Its outflow feeds the Silver River.[2]

Geography

[edit]

The lake lies at an altitude of 1,850 m. Its surface area is described by A for a circular basin.

Climate (1991–2020)

Winters are long and the lake is frozen from November to May.
